Create a question-index template from a folder

Source: R/index.R
create_question_index.Rd

Scans a folder recursively for .qmd and .Rmd question fragments. IDs are inferred from filenames and titles from the first H2 heading. The metadata that cannot be inferred safely is left as NA; complete those fields before calling validate_question_bank().

Usage

create_question_index(questions_dir, output_file = NULL, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

questions_dir

Folder containing question fragments.

output_file

Optional CSV path to write. If omitted, the template is returned without writing a file.

overwrite

Whether an existing output_file may be replaced.

Value

A data frame invisibly when written, and visibly otherwise.

Examples

questions <- system.file("extdata", "questions", package = "ecosanctuary")
template <- create_question_index(questions)
template[c("id", "file", "title")]
